summary: Anfield Energy Inc., a Canadian uranium development company, filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of an underwritten public offering of 1,715,000 common shares, including full exercise of the underwriters' option for 233,695 additional shares, at US$4.00 per share for gross proceeds of US$6.9 million. The offering was led by Northland Capital Markets and Roth Capital Partners, with participation from strategic investor Uranium Energy Corp. Proceeds will fund capital commitments to the Paradox Complex, Velvet-Wood Project, Slick Rock Complex, and Shootaring Canyon Mill, plus working capital. Underwriter discounts totaled approximately $261,600. The filing documents a routine equity raise under an existing shelf, not a special-situation event, so no risk-arb angle applies.
